## Summary Ten consecutive local runs of `E2E_WORKERS=22 npm run test:smoke` each produced 4–6 test failures (never a clean run; 50 failure instances total). The failures cluster on a small, highly repeatable, **closed** set of timing-sensitive WebGL interaction tests — no new test signatures appeared after Run 5 — dominated by Chromium. This documents the raw data for future investigation and root-cause analysis of parallel-worker instability. ## Environment - Command: `E2E_WORKERS=22 npm run test:smoke` (build + Playwright, local, `retries: 0`) - Worker resolution: local opt-in parallel via `E2E_WORKERS` - Platform: Linux (WSL2) - Host: 24 logical CPUs, 27 GiB RAM (22 workers on 24 CPUs) - Toolchain: Node v22.23.1, npm 10.9.8, `@playwright/test` 1.61.1 - Commit: `f1eebf7` - Date: 2026-07-24 ## Failure tally (10 runs) | Test | Browser | Failures / 10 runs | |---|---|---| | `smoke.spec.ts:78` renders the graph and exercises its core controls | chromium | **10/10** | | `matrix.spec.ts:225` zooms in with the wheel and rotates with a background drag | chromium | **9/10** | | `matrix.spec.ts:572` remounts a fresh working canvas on re-navigation | chromium | **9/10** | | `matrix.spec.ts:135` keeps pointer navigation inert until the enable delay elapses | firefox | **8/10** | | `matrix.spec.ts:195` zooms out with the wheel | chromium | 6/10 | | `smoke.spec.ts:78` renders the graph and exercises its core controls | firefox | 2/10 | | `matrix.spec.ts:135` keeps pointer navigation inert until the enable delay elapses | chromium | 2/10 | | `matrix.spec.ts:225` zooms in with the wheel and rotates with a background drag | firefox | 2/10 | | `matrix.spec.ts:314` click-to-focus fixes the node, animates the camera, and re-navigation ``` ## Error signatures (from full Run 6–10 output) Full error output was captured for Runs 6–10 (`run_6.txt` … `run_10.txt`). Every failure instance falls into one of six signatures: ### A. Wheel input produces ZERO camera delta — chromium `matrix.spec.ts:195`, `:225`, and `:135` (post-enablement assert) The dominant Chromium matrix signature. The camera distance received is **byte-identical to the starting distance** — the wheel event had no effect at all within the 5 s settle predicate, not a partial/slow zoom: ``` Error: wheel up should zoom the camera out Expected: > 2377.6053243146093 (start + ZOOM_EPSILON) Received: 2377.1053243146093 (== start, unchanged) Call Log: Timeout 5000ms exceeded while waiting on the predicate at matrix.spec.ts:220 (.toBeGreaterThan(start.cameraDistance + ZOOM_EPSILON)) ``` Same shape for zoom-in (`:225`, `Received == start` at matrix.spec.ts:246) in Runs 7, 8, 9, 10; zoom-out (`:195`) in Runs 6, 7, 9, 10. Run 10's chromium `:135` failure is this signature too — the *post-enablement* wheel assert got a delta of `1.59e-11` (effectively zero) against `ZOOM_EPSILON = 0.5`. ### B. Click hangs forever on "visible, enabled and stable" — chromium `smoke.spec.ts:78` (all of Runs 6–10) The 120 s test timeout expires inside `locator.click` on the rotation toggle. The locator **resolves** (the button is in the DOM with the right text) but the click actionability check never passes: ``` Error: locator.click: Test timeout of 120000ms exceeded. - waiting for getByRole('button', { name: 'Resume Auto Rotation', exact: true }) - locator resolved to - attempting click action - waiting for element to be visible, enabled and stable at smoke.spec.ts:172 ``` Runs 6, 8, 9, 10 stall at `smoke.spec.ts:172` (Resume click); Run 7 got one click further and stalled at `:174` (Pause click). ### C. Re-navigation aborts / test times out — chromium `matrix.spec.ts:572` (all of Runs 6–10) Runs 6–9: bare `Test timeout of 120000ms exceeded.` Run 10 captured the underlying failure — the second `page.goto("/")` dies: ``` Error: page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED; maybe frame was detached? - navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:3000/", waiting until "load" at matrix.spec.ts:577 ``` ### D. Controls already enabled at the early probe — firefox `matrix.spec.ts:135` (Runs 6, 7, 8, 10) The test's "early" probe finds controls **already enabled**: ``` Error: navigation controls should start disabled Expected: false Received: true (early.controlsEnabled) at matrix.spec.ts:149 ``` ### E. Camera motion never observed / never settles — firefox `matrix.spec.ts:314` (Run 6), firefox `matrix.spec.ts:225` (Run 9) Run 6, click-to-focus: camera motion count stayed `0` against `MOTION_FLOOR = 1` for 10 s (matrix.spec.ts:447) — matches the known #34 signature. Run 9, firefox zoom test: `waitForStableCameraDistance` (graph-handle.ts:845) timed out after 15 s — the camera never stabilized enough to even start the wheel assertion. ### F. UI chrome never renders — firefox `smoke.spec.ts:78` (Run 7) `getByRole('button', { name: 'Show Axes' })` not found within 5 s (smoke.spec.ts:125) — the page hadn't rendered its control buttons at all within the assertion budget. ## Observations - **No clean runs**: every run failed, with 4–6 failures per run (50 failure instances across 10 runs). - **The failure set is closed**: Runs 6–10 introduced no new test signatures — all failures fall within the same 9 test×browser combinations seen in Runs 1–5. Instability at 22 workers is confined to a specific, enumerable set of tests, not spread randomly across the suite. - **Deterministic core**: `[chromium] smoke.spec.ts:78` failed in **all 10 runs**; `[chromium] matrix.spec.ts:225` and `[chromium] matrix.spec.ts:572` in 9/10; `[firefox] matrix.spec.ts:135` in 8/10. - **Error output is on record for Runs 6–10**: Chromium wheel failures show *exactly zero* camera delta (received == start to full float precision), the smoke failure is Playwright's element-stability check never passing within 120 s, and Run 10's remount failure surfaced a `net::ERR_ABORTED; maybe frame was detached?` on re-navigation. Interpretation deferred to the future investigation. - **`matrix.spec.ts:195` (wheel zoom-out) worsened in the second batch**: 2/5 in Runs 1–5 vs 4/5 in Runs 6–10 (6/10 overall) — it belongs in the high-frequency Chromium cluster, not the tail. - **Consistent with issue #41's qualification finding**: parallel workers destabilize the timing-sensitive `matrix.spec.ts` camera-settle/drag assertions under SwiftShader CPU contention (#41 observed 4–5 of 22 Chromium tests failing on every parallel run). This dataset at `E2E_WORKERS=22` reproduces that failure profile and is the standing reason the local `retries: 0` gate stays serial. - The enable-delay test (`matrix.spec.ts:135`) fails predominantly on **Firefox** (8/10) versus Chromium (2/10), and with *different* error signatures per browser: Firefox fails the "controls should start disabled" precondition (signature D), while Chromium's Run-10 failure was the post-enablement wheel producing no zoom (signature A). ## Suggested investigation 1. Re-run the failing tests with traces/videos enabled at high worker counts to capture whether failures are camera-settle timeouts, missed drag deltas, or WebGL context loss — and, for the zero-delta wheel signature, whether events are never dispatched or dispatched but dropped. 2. Investigate signature C (`net::ERR_ABORTED; maybe frame was detached?` on re-navigation) — e.g. check Chromium crashpad logs or run with `--headed`/tracing at 22 workers to determine whether the renderer crashed. 3. Characterize the worker-count threshold (e.g. 2, 4, 8, 16, 22) to find where instability begins, especially on the native-GPU lane vs SwiftShader. 4. Determine whether the near-always-failing Chromium cluster (`smoke.spec.ts:78`, `matrix.spec.ts:225`, `matrix.spec.ts:572`) shares a common assertion or fixture. 5. Decide whether these tests can be made contention-tolerant (event/state-based waits instead of timing windows) or should be annotated serial-only. ## Related - #41 — qualified parallel workers; found they destabilize timing-sensitive matrix assertions (basis for the serial local default) - #34 — click-to-focus camera/click timing flake on CI (the `matrix.spec.ts:314` failures in Runs 4 and 6 match this signature; Run 6 error output: camera motion count 0 for 10 s) - #55 — Firefox background-drag flake (fixed; noted for history) Raw source data: `22_worker_testing.txt` (10-run failure log); `run_6.txt` … `run_10.txt` (full error output for Runs 6–10).
